overview: Scarlet Desert is a brutal wasteland shaped by Luclin’s intense sunlight and geomantic instability.
history: Once a stable mesa system, the region fractured during ancient lunar upheavals. Sun revenants emerged from resonance between crystal fields and solar magic.
hooks: A massive sunstorm sweeps across the dunes.
Sun revenants gather near twilight ridges.
A caravan disappears near the Acrylia frontier.
A new crimson dune reveals buried ruins.
